summary: EDENOR, the Argentine electricity distributor, furnished a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a current report) disclosing that its Board accepted the resignation of Ms. Flavia Bevilacqua as Alternate Director for strictly personal reasons. She had been appointed by the Class B shareholder at the Ordinary and Extraordinary General Shareholders Meeting of April 29, 2026. No stake, price, premium, advisor or board recommendation is stated, and no transaction mechanics apply. The change is a routine board-level vacancy rather than a forced senior executive event; no deal or risk-arb angle arises.
